# Default AMBA ALZ deployment

This baseline E2E example deploys the AMBA resource group, user-assigned managed identity, and default Monitoring Reader role assignment. Optional module settings retain their defaults.

The example creates a uniquely named management group with AzAPI instead of assuming that an `alz` management group exists. No subscriptions or existing management groups are moved into it. Names remain stable for the lifetime of the Terraform state.

## Prerequisites and cleanup

The authenticated identity needs permission to create and delete management groups under the tenant's configured default management group, manage role assignments on the new group, and deploy resources into the selected subscription. Subscription-only permissions are not sufficient for the management-group operations.

Run `avm test e2e --example default` from the repository root to deploy, check idempotency, and destroy the example. Terraform owns the prerequisite management group and removes the module's role assignment before deleting it. Do not import an existing management group into this example's state or move subscriptions into the test group.

For the full ALZ policy composition, see the `complete` and `custom-architecture-definition` examples.

```hcl
provider "azurerm" {
  features {}
}

module "naming" {
  source  = "Azure/avm-utl-naming/azure"
  version = "0.3.0"
}

resource "azapi_resource" "management_group" {
  name      = "mg-default-${module.naming.resource_group.name_unique}"
  parent_id = "/"
  type      = var.resource_types.management_management_groups
  body = {
    properties = {
      displayName = "AMBA default E2E"
    }
  }
  ignore_body_changes    = length(var.ignore_body_changes.management_management_groups) > 0 ? var.ignore_body_changes.management_management_groups : null
  response_export_values = []
  retry                  = var.retry

  dynamic "timeouts" {
    for_each = var.timeouts == null ? [] : [var.timeouts]
    content {
      create = timeouts.value.create
      read   = timeouts.value.read
      update = timeouts.value.update
      delete = timeouts.value.delete
    }
  }
}

module "amba_alz" {
  source = "../../"

  location                            = var.location
  root_management_group_name          = azapi_resource.management_group.name
  enable_telemetry                    = var.enable_telemetry
  resource_group_name                 = module.naming.resource_group.name_unique
  user_assigned_managed_identity_name = module.naming.user_assigned_identity.name_unique
}
```

## Required Inputs

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_enable_telemetry"></a> [enable\_telemetry](#input\_enable\_telemetry)

Description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module.  
For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>.  
If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

Type: `bool`

Default: `true`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Body-relative dot-notation paths to ignore on the test management group. Changes take effect after apply; ignored properties are not sent to Azure until their paths are removed.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    management_management_groups = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_location"></a> [location](#input\_location)

Description: Azure region for the AMBA resource group and managed identity.

Type: `string`

Default: `"swedencentral"`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: AzAPI resource types used by the test setup. management\_management\_groups configures the isolated management group's resource type and API version.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    management_management_groups = optional(string, "Microsoft.Management/managementGroups@2021-04-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Optional retry settings for the test management group: error\_message\_regex selects retryable errors; interval\_seconds, max\_interval\_seconds, multiplier, and randomization\_factor control backoff.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
    multiplier           = optional(number)
    randomization_factor = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Optional create, read, update, and delete timeouts for the test management group, expressed as Go duration strings such as 10m. Null uses provider defaults.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string)
    read   = optional(string)
    update = optional(string)
    delete = optional(string)
  })
```

Default: `null`
